modules.model_type: District Historical OLS Linear Trend + 5-Year Rolling Mean Blend (district-trend-v1)
modules.metric_value: LOYO MAE: 194.75 kg/ha (RMSE 253.42 kg/ha) | LODO MAE: 256.89 kg/ha (RMSE 323.09 kg/ha) across 3,040 district-crop-year records
modules.data_source: Directorate of Economics & Statistics (DES), Department of Agriculture, Government of Rajasthan (2005–2023 historical yields)
limitations: Baseline relies on historical district-level trends; extreme episodic weather anomalies (unseasonal hail/frost) require manual adjustment
Covers all 33 statistical districts (mapped across 41 administrative districts) of Rajasthan for 6 major crops
Advisory yield assumes standard Package of Practices (POP) management without severe pest outbreaks

modules.model_type: Persistence + Lag-7 Rolling Window Mean Baseline
modules.metric_value: Baseline Persistence (7-day window std dev: ±₹120-180/qtl on APMC spot data)
modules.data_source: Agmarknet via Data.gov.in Government API (National APMC Price & Arrivals Feeds)
limitations: Spot prices reflect registered APMC arrivals; informal village-level farmgate transactions may deviate by 5-10%
Forecasts assume historical seasonality and normal market arrivals; cannot anticipate sudden export bans or tariff shifts
Requires minimum 28 days continuous daily arrivals for statistical confidence intervals

modules.metric_value: Test Top-1 Accuracy: 97.21% (Val: 97.40%) | Test Macro-F1: 0.9297 across 24 classes (Train 18,152 / Val 3,878 / Test 3,913 images)
modules.data_source: PlantVillage + Authentic Pearl Millet, Mustard & Wheat Disease Datasets (Deduplicated with MD5 non-leaking splits)
limitations: Mobile ONNX inference relies on device camera focus and good natural lighting
Any prediction with confidence under 70% automatically triggers mandatory Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) scientist referral
Only identifies visible foliar symptoms; cannot diagnose subterranean nematode damage or systemic viral wilt without lab assay

modules.module: Irrigation Scheduling & Agro-Advisory (मौसम व सिंचाई सलाह)
modules.model_type: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith Evapotranspiration (Physics-based deterministic agronomic formula, 0% ML hallucination)
modules.accuracy_metric: Physical Conservation of Energy / Water Balance (ET0 mm/day)
modules.metric_value: Deterministic Physics (R² = 1.0 against standard FAO-56 Penman-Monteith tables)
modules.data_source: Open-Meteo High-Resolution Hourly Forecast API + ICAR & AU Kota / SKNAU Crop Coefficients (Kc)
limitations: ET0 calculated using 10m wind speed, relative humidity, solar radiation and temperature grids at 0.1° (~11km) resolution
Rainfall forecasts beyond 72 hours carry higher uncertainty from numerical weather prediction (NWP) models
Soil moisture sensor inputs will enhance future releases; currently estimates root zone depletion based on sowing date
